title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_4
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FBI case files regarding 'Flying Discs' and 'Flying Saucers' from 1947-1949, containing multiple reports of sightings and investigations, including debunked claims. / This document collection contains various FBI memoranda, teletypes, and correspondence regarding reports of 'flying discs' and 'unconventional aircraft' between 1947 and 1949, including several specific encounter reports.

encounters.summary: Police officers in Portland, Oregon, observed a bright, silvery, round or elliptical object reflecting sunlight, moving steadily at high speed and altitude.
encounters.entity_appearance: silvery metal, round or elliptical, bright reflection
encounters.entity_behavior: steady flight, no oscillation, high speed
encounters.quote: very bright reflection of the sun on some object which was apparently made of silvery metal

encounters.summary: Pilot Jack Peck and co-pilot Vince Daly observed a dark, wing-shaped object without fuselage or visible propulsion near Bethel, Alaska.
encounters.entity_appearance: dark, flying wing, size of C-54 without fuselage
encounters.entity_behavior: flying at 1,000 feet, estimated 300 mph, concise outline
encounters.quote: did not blend into the sky but had a definite, concise outline

encounters.summary: Lonnie Noack and companions located a crashed object in the California desert, described as a disc with wings and jet propulsion containers.
encounters.entity_appearance: 8-foot diameter disc, 2 feet thick, 4-foot wings, aluminum construction
encounters.quote: object which could be described as being 8' in diameter with wings about 4' long

encounters.summary: Eastern Airlines pilot and co-pilot reported an unconventional, wingless, rocket-ship-like craft with windows, larger than their plane, traveling at high speed near Montgomery, Alabama.
encounters.quote: unconventional type without wings and resembled generally a rocket ship

encounters.summary: A post office employee observed a brilliant, mirror-like object moving at high altitude in Fort Smith, Arkansas.
encounters.quote: brilliant object moving in a southeastern direction

encounters.summary: Three employees of the Department of Recreation and Parks observed objects appearing to be flying discs in Griffith Park.
encounters.quote: noticed an object sailing through the sky

encounters.summary: A military officer observed a lighted, basketball-sized reddish-white object with a fire trail pass over Killeen Base.
encounters.quote: lighted object about the size of a basketball, reddish white in color

encounters.summary: A major in the Air Force Reserve observed a solid mass object with a clicking noise that maneuvered in the sky.
encounters.quote: object was observed blanking out stars in describing a flight path

encounters.summary: A witness observed an angular, paper-like object in the sky that changed shape and appeared to be on fire.
encounters.quote: shape was angular, more like a piece of torn paper
